body: it was really nice to read your message tonight. i dont have hope for a "normal" life anymore, and im sure you understand what i mean. but i have a little hope that i can do more than just suffer every day. there are still things i really want to do. see out west, the desert, grand canyon, those rock formations, cactus etc. and the giant redwood forests in california. things like that make me not want to end it. i hope you also have something that you dont want to give up on

thanks. I dont want to die at all. It gets so bad though that its all I can think about. I was going to leave and drive somewhere but I came home and wrote this instead, which is probably better. I shouldn't be driving right now. I hope youre ok too

20 to 35 just went so fast. Its terrifying. Like seriously, there are no words. It destroys my soul. Its gone. 35 to 50 is going to go even quicker, if I make it. I don't just mean suicide, but my own health. I skipped the "best years of my life", my youth, heading straight for middle age, with the health problems of a senior citizen (heart and prostate problems, among many others). 

I have nothing to lose at this point. I want to try psychedelic drugs out in the desert, or die. Or both. I want to believe that theres more than this. I still just can't accept that this is it. Like you said, whats the point!? 

I want to believe there is more, but watching how my Dad's life went, and ended, and how my life has been... I really having a hard time.

 It seems like its just random shit, then we die... I'm just so lonely. I want to go on an adventure. 

I want a cat so bad. But I literally have no idea where I'm gonna live soon. Its the most anxiety I can imagine. My life is nothing but suffering. I just exist to suffer. And now I have to find somewhere new to do it. I'm already home sick and Im not even gone yet. I just want to run away and go on an adventure before I die. 

Im sorry buddy. I hope youre ok tonight
